offers_products.reason: Main offerings are inspection, repair and heat treating services; OEM valve parts are incidental to repair work.

offers_services.reason: NDT inspection, leak repair, post-weld heat treating, rope access and turnaround field services for industrial sites.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Customers are refineries, pipelines, power plants and chemical facilities, not households.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Sells inspection and repair services to industrial operators such as refineries, pipelines, power and chemical plants.

recurring_revenue.reason: Recurring inspection, maintenance, emissions-compliance and repair work for the same plant operators, often under ongoing programs.

cyclical_demand.reason: Inspection, leak repair and compliance work is maintenance and safety driven, so it is hard to postpone.

big_ticket.reason: Routine inspection, repair and heat treating jobs are frequent, though turnarounds can be larger.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for certified technicians' time and skill in NDT, repair and heat treating; service stops without crews.

large_customers.reason: Main customers are large refineries, pipeline operators, power plants and chemical facilities.

asset_heavy.reason: Mobile crews and portable equipment serve client sites; growth needs people and tools, not plants or networks.
